html:
Georgia Home Services Cost Guide

Build Heritage gives you a clear, itemized estimate for any home‑service project in Georgia. We cover eight trades—Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles—across metro Atlanta and the state.

How to get a quote for a roof replacement in Atlanta

  1. Visit the roofing page and click “Request a Quote.”
  2. Enter your address in Atlanta and describe the work.
  3. Receive a written, itemized quote within one business day.
  4. Review the quote and confirm the project.

The 2026 cost guide lists a full roof replacement at $9,000‑$20,000. Hold back an extra 10‑15% for hidden issues.

What you get

  • Free, written, itemized quote for any of the eight trades.
  • Response within one business day.
  • Licensed and insured in Georgia.
  • Quote includes labor, materials, and disposal fees.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We cover Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

Can I get a cost estimate for a whole‑home interior repaint? Yes. The cost guide shows a range of $3,000‑$8,000. Request a quote on the painting page for a detailed estimate.

What if I need to hold back money for hidden issues? The guide recommends setting aside 10‑15% above the quoted amount for unforeseen problems.

Get your free quote now
